name: Google Calendar

permissions.description: Explicit HTTPS Google Calendar v3 calls with supplied OAuth token. Confirmed writes can create, change, share or delete calendars/events. Alternative secret names require host authorization; no retries, refresh, filesystem or listeners.

definitions.name: Get Calendar
definitions.description: Get Calendar
definitions.documentation: Get Calendar: GET /calendars/{calendarId}. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.name: Create Secondary Calendar
definitions.description: Create Secondary Calendar
definitions.documentation: Create Secondary Calendar: POST /calendars. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation CALENDARS_INSERT. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. definitions.description: Add Existing Calendar To My List
definitions.documentation: Add Existing Calendar To My List: POST /users/me/calendarList. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation CALENDAR_LIST_INSERT. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. definitions.name: Patch My Calendar Entry
definitions.description: Patch My Calendar Entry
definitions.documentation: Patch My Calendar Entry: PATCH /users/me/calendarList/{calendarId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation CALENDAR_LIST_PATCH. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. definitions.name: List Events
definitions.description: List Events
definitions.documentation: List Events: GET /calendars/{calendarId}/events. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. definitions.name: Create Event
definitions.description: Create Event
definitions.documentation: Create Event: POST /calendars/{calendarId}/events. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation EVENTS_INSERT. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. definitions.name: Import Private Event Copy
definitions.description: Import Private Event Copy
definitions.documentation: Import Private Event Copy: POST /calendars/{calendarId}/events/import. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation EVENTS_IMPORT. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.name: Patch Event
definitions.description: Patch Event
definitions.documentation: Patch Event: PATCH /calendars/{calendarId}/events/{eventId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation EVENTS_PATCH. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.documentation: Create Calendar Access Rule: POST /calendars/{calendarId}/acl. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation ACL_INSERT. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. definitions.documentation: Get Calendar And Event Colors: GET /colors. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. definitions.code: function bounded(v){const stack=[[v,0,false]],active=new Set();let count=0;while(stack.length){const [x,d,exit]=stack.pop();if(exit){active.delete(x);continue;}if(d>90||++count>200000)throw Error('Value complexity bound');if(x===null||typeof x==='string'||typeof x==='boolean')continue;if(typeof x==='number'&&Number.isFinite(x))continue;if(!x||typeof x!=='object'||active.has(x)||!Array.isArray(x)&&![Object.prototype,null].includes(Object.getPrototypeOf(x)))throw Error('Finite acyclic JSON required');active.add(x);stack.push([x,d,true]);for(const y of Array.isArray(x)?x:Object.values(x))stack.push([y,d+1,false]);}if(Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(v))>1048576)throw Error('Value exceeds 1 MiB');return v;}const value=bounded(inputs.value),fields=["query"],aliases={"query":"query"},out=Object.create(null);for(const k of fields)if(Object.hasOwn(value,k))out[aliases[k]]=value[k];return out;

definitions.documentation: Query Calendar Free Busy: POST /freeBusy. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners.
